subject: 'Node inconsistent with parent' when modeling gamma in Jolly-Seber model

messages.author: bfa4a88c8a5bc54e
messages.subject: 'Node inconsistent with parent' when modeling gamma in Jolly-Seber model
parts:
Good day all,

I'm currently working on a multistate Jolly-Seber model with four states: not yet entered, alive and disease-free, alive and with disease, and dead. I am modeling survival of both alive groups, the disease transition probabilities, and capture probabilities with logit-link functions without any issue. However, when I try to model the recruitment parameter gamma[t] as a function of time and time-squared (I've observed a peak in estimated recruitment probabilities and I want to estimate the peak arrival at the site as a function of time), I get the error 'Node consistent with parent'. The moment I model gamma[t] as a simple time-varying covariate with dunif(0,1), there's no dramas.

The code here is as follows:

    for(t in 1:(n.occasions-1)){
#      logit(gamma[t]) <-  gamma.x0 +
#                          gamma.x[1]*(t-1) +
#                          gamma.x[2]*(t-1)*(t-1)
      gamma[t] ~ dunif(0,1)
    }

#    gamma.x0 <- log(gamma.0/(1-gamma.0))
#    gamma.0 ~ dunif(0,1)
#    gamma.x0 ~ dnorm(0,0.368) # Don't need gamma.0
#    gamma.x[1] ~ dnorm(0,0.368)
#    gamma.x[2] ~ dnorm(0,0.368)

So everything that has a hashtag in front of it is how I'd like to model it. However, I'm currently stuck just using gamma[t] ~ dunif(0,1).

Any idea why this is happening? I'm happy to provide the full code as well.

Cheers,
Matt
